title: What do you see?
text: The blue region represents $$\frac{3}{4}$$ of the unit square. The yellow overlap regions depicts $$\frac{2}{3} rds$$ of that blue region.

title: Which relationship?
text: $$\frac{2}{3}$$ of $$\frac{3}{4}$$ is a multiplication problem. The general rule is $$\frac{a}{b} \frac{c}{d}=\frac{ac}{bd}$$
